pair.title: Connect to your Yizuo
pair.subtitle: Mint a pairing code on the web (Settings → Paired devices), then scan or type it to bind this device to your account.
pair.scanHint: The QR carries both the server address and the code — nothing to type.
pair.cameraDenied: Camera unavailable — type the server address and the 6-digit code instead.
pair.errCode: Invalid or expired code — mint a fresh one and retry.
pair.errNetwork: Cannot reach the server — check the address and your network.
pair.errOldServer: This server predates device pairing; upgrade Yizuo to use it.

gate.rebind: This device's binding was revoked — pair again.

chat.placeholderBody: The full chat lane lands with tasks 3.x.

cron.placeholderBody: The task list lands with task 4.3.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unbindConfirm: Unbinding clears local pairing and returns to the pairing screen. Continue?

share.title: Shared session
share.unavailable: The share is gone or was revoked.
